en: This version has no update service. Contact your administrator for a newer installer.
zh: 此版本未连接更新服务，请联系管理员获取新版安装包

en: Could not read update settings. Check your connection and try again.
zh: 无法读取更新配置，请检查网络后重试

en: Update settings are invalid. Ask your administrator to check the backend settings.
zh: 更新配置无效，请联系管理员检查后台设置

en: Your administrator has not enabled client updates.
zh: 管理员尚未开启客户端更新

en: No update source is configured for this device. Contact your administrator.
zh: 尚未配置此设备的更新源，请联系管理员

en: Automatic updates are unavailable on this device. Contact your administrator for an installer.
zh: 此设备暂不支持自动更新，请联系管理员获取安装包

en: Development builds do not support automatic updates. Use a release installer.
zh: 开发版本不支持自动更新，请使用正式安装包
